subject: Fermi GRB 260808A: Global MASTER-Net observations report

body:

MASTER-OAFA robotic telescope  [1]  located in Argentina (OAFA observatory of San Juan National University) started inspect of the Fermi GRB 260808A ( Fermi GBM team, GCN 45313) errorbox  99 sec after notice time and 136 sec after trigger time at 2026-08-08 02:53:58 UT, with upper limit up to  19.2 mag. The observations began at zenith distance = 68 deg. The sun  altitude  is -61.1 deg. 

The galactic latitude b = -39 deg., longitude l = 84 deg.


Real time updated cover map and OT discovered available here: 
https://master.sai.msu.ru/site/master2/observ.php?id=3463356
